items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: "For doing what you did to Adam, you shall have your head stomped into the ground."

ctx.x: they suck it in. Now, certainly the rock reptile is something else. They are very wise. That Bible scene, you know, where they say, "For doing what you did to Adam, you shall have your head stomped into the ground."

So he and I, we took up right away. He was a master baker, which is called... He was an oven man, which is the baker that goes to the oven, raises up the hood and puts the bread in and takes the bread out. Time. It's got to be timed perfectly, or you lose a batch. I should have been a baker. But I wrapped bread for a while. You'd wrap the bread... They'd bring it out, you'd let it cool, then you'd wrap it.
